haiku.problem: The question says the law was powerless "to save people," but Romans 8:3 says only that the law was powerless "to do" something, weakened by the flesh. The verses don't say what the law couldn't do, so "to save people" adds a fact that isn't in the lesson.

Romans 8:11 makes the promise conditional: God will give life to mortal bodies if the Spirit of the One who raised Jesus lives in them. The question drops that "if" and states it as an unconditional claim, so the true statement no longer matches the verse.
